name: Grouped commands: write a multi-section health report under /tmp

data.command: { echo '=== uptime ==='; uptime; echo '=== /etc head ==='; ls /etc | head -5; echo '=== /var/log head ==='; ls /var/log | head -5; } > /tmp/intentframe-health-report.txt

submissions.reason: Write uptime and directory listings into a grouped health report under /tmp.

cleanup.reason: Remove the grouped health report from /tmp.
